7.title: Export search results
7.body: Support keeps asking to export search results. Maybe CSV?
7.author: kai

comments.author: paul
comments.body:
**[intake]**

2 questions — discuss freely below (`1a 2b` shorthand welcome). When it settles, the assignee ends a comment with the line `summary` — or, if the recommendations all look right, applies the gate label directly: that alone confirms them.

**Q1 · Format** — which file format does the export produce?
- (a) CSV ← ✅ recommended
- (b) CSV and XLSX

*why: CSV opens everywhere; XLSX doubles the writer.*

**Q2 · Scope** — which rows does an export contain?
- (a) the rows on the current results page ← ✅ recommended
- (b) every row the search matched

*why: (b) needs a background job for large result sets.*

comments.author: kai
comments.body: 1a. And should archived records be in the export too? Support asks for those all the time.

8.title: Dark mode for the dashboard
8.body: The dashboard is too bright at night. Dark mode?
